Golf story is worth the price. 14.99 and about 16.47 or so after taxes. I'm about level 5 and in Lurker valley now.

The animations are great, the controls are tight and game play has been fun.

Controls: You have your basic golf game where you press 3 times to swing. Once to initial the shot, once to start, and once to end.

What i didn't expect is the options you have to actually hit the ball. You can alter the shot, how it will curve. You can do a precision shot where it marks on the meter where you want to start your swing. That is a nice touch. You can also adjust if you hit the ball on the top or bottom to control the spin.

The RPG mechanics are great. You level up and can put points into 5 different categories. The trick. You can't just dump everything in power. If you do then it lowers the other attributes, giving you negatives. I mean you can dump them all there but your gonna slice your shots. It is a nice touch in my books.
